title: Sponky starts the discovery
caption: Sponky spots a change in your money and gives you a way to explore it.
note: Open with Sponky surfacing an observed balance change and inviting exploration. This is an in-app insight, not a background notification. The bank entry is a concept, not a live S-mobiili integration.

title: Sponky guides the exploration
caption: Ask in your own words. Sponky explains the pattern and offers a way to explore it.
note: Use actual voice footage here in the final video. The illustrated response uses the August 2026 demo targets.

title: Sponky makes the spending understandable
caption: Sponky explains your three baskets, then spots the gap between your surplus and investments.
note: The 16,90 € surplus is before investment transfers. The 186,58 € investment comparison is an observed monthly pattern, not evidence of savings achieved.

title: Sponky checks what the goal takes
caption: Sponky checks your goal against your history and shows the change it would take.
note: The six-month target keeps the recorded investment allocation. Only explicit confirmation sets the goal.

title: Sponky turns the goal into next steps
caption: Once you confirm, Sponky turns your goal into a spending plan for the week.
note: 93,28 € is the jar-based allowance for 17–20 September, excluding the simulated current day. It is not a verified bank balance or a guarantee about future bills.

title: Sponky guides and celebrates the check-up
caption: Sponky guides your weekly check-up and celebrates each time you show up.
note: Illustrates three completed weekly check-ups on 2, 9 and 16 September. The dedicated streak screen is planned in #51 and remains to be verified in the integrated product. Do not imply measured retention or savings impact.

title: Sponky guides. The user decides.
caption: Sponky guides the conversation with checked numbers. You stay in control of the goal.
note: Architecture and providers reflect the project. S-mobiili embedding remains a proposed integration. The new coaching flow still requires combined acceptance under #50.

title: The promise to remember
caption: Sponky. Spots the pattern. Guides your next step. Builds the habit with you.
note: Close on the product promise and demo address. Do not claim proven improvements in financial literacy; this prototype demonstrates the approach.
